originalText:
CORRECT INQUISITOR

DIFFICULTY 5

Size 1/2 or 1 human
Perception 10 (+0)
Defense 12; Health 16; Insanity 3; Corruption 1
Strength 12 (+2), Agility 12 (+2), Intellect 10 (+0), Will 9 (–1)
Speed 10
Cruel Reality The inquisitor deals 3d6 extra damage to
dazed and stunned targets.
Unraveling the Equation The inquisitor makes challenge
rolls with 1 boon.

ATTACK OPTIONS
Dagger (melee or short range) +2 with 1 boon (1d3 plus 1d6)
Whip (melee; reach) +2 with 1 boon (1d3 plus 1d6)

SPECIAL ATTACKS
Confounding Query The inquisitor can use an action to
pose a question to a creature within short range and
compel an answer from it. The inquisitor makes an
Intellect attack roll with 1 boon against the target’s
Intellect. On a success, the target becomes dazed for
1 round. On a failure, the target becomes immune to all
uses of Confounding Query until it completes a rest.

SPECIAL ACTIONS
Correct Inspiration When a member of the Correct within
short range of the inquisitor makes an attack roll or
challenge roll, the inquisitor can use a triggered action to
grant 1 boon on the triggering roll.

--- PDF p. 5 ---

name: CORRECT INFILTRATOR

source.reason: Explicit CUR-003 source reference; edition/permission not certified.

originalText:
CORRECT INFILTRATOR

DIFFICULTY 5

Size 1/2 or 1 human
Perception 12 (+2)
Defense 12; Health 13; Insanity 1; Corruption 1
Strength 9 (–1), Agility 12 (+2), Intellect 12 (+2), Will 10 (+0)
Speed 10
Improvised Cover The infiltrator imposes 1 bane on attack
rolls made against it for each creature it can reach that is
not the attacker.
Unraveling the Equation The infiltrator makes challenge
rolls with 1 boon.

ATTACK OPTIONS
Dagger (melee or short range) +2 with 1 boon (1d3 plus 1d6)
Sling (medium range) +2 with 1 boon (1d3 plus 1d6)

SPECIAL ACTIONS
Correct the Math When a creature the infiltrator can see
gets a success on an attack roll against the infiltrator’s
Defense, the infiltrator can reduce the total of the attack
roll by 1d6. If this reduction would turn the success into
a failure, the infiltrator gains one action and can use it
immediately. Once the infiltrator uses Correct the Math,
it must wait 1 round before it can use it again.

While many cultists are groomed toward the various
specialties of the Correct’s activities, they are often
supported, whether overtly or in the shadows, by the rankand-file of the cult.

CORRECT CULTIST

DIFFICULTY 1

Size 1/2 or 1 human

Whether on the road or amid their plans within the
settlement, the Correct is cautious and subtle. They have
no desire to enter into needless conflicts with local toughs
or meddling adventurers. The first encounter with the
Correct is nearly always pleasant and helpful. They have
been known to provide information and even support
adventurers on this quest or another. Usually, when doing
so, it’s the cult’s goal to reduce variables that may work
against its ultimate goals, but other times, such patronages
are tied to Sama’s strange revelations. No matter the case,
many adventurers find themselves supported by the cult
only to come back to its aftermath and the suspicion of the
ordeal’s survivors.

Power Plays

What precisely empowers Sama and her cultists’
capabilities? Well, that is up to you. It could be that the
Correct are just a strange cult to some unknown power. It
could be that Sama is right—or at least partially so.
In the end, it’s good to keep what powers the Correct
flexible. They’re strange people with bizarre goals—
shifting their tactics for an inflexible purpose. In later
days, the cult might pick up some magical training or start
practicing unusual religious rites falling under the sway
of other powers all toward reaching their goals. In these
cases, consider adding either magician or priest templates
(Shadow, page 265) to cult members to reflect such changes
and increase the Correct’s threat.

Perception 11 (+1)
Defense 8; Health 10; Insanity 1; Corruption 0
Strength 10 (+0), Agility 8 (-2), Intellect 11 (+1), Will 9 (–1)
Speed 10
Balancing the Equation When a cultist makes an attack
roll or challenge roll, it can make the roll with 2 boons.
If it gets a failure on the roll, it makes attack rolls and
challenge rolls with 2 banes for 1 round.

ATTACK OPTIONS
Club (melee) +0 (1d6)

5
